answer: Slashable accuracy bonds. Each claim in an atlas of velvet textures or willow disease must lock a separate deposit until its audit window closes. A verifier randomly checks the signed claim against authenticated source measurements; proven fabrication forfeits the bond. N simultaneous accounts require N locked deposits, and false claims face an expected loss equal to audit probability times the bond. Set that loss above the false-claim reward. This assumes reliable ground truth and audits the attacker cannot predict or control.
